newsitem.title: USA: Equitable of Iowa Q4 net up after purchase.
newsitem.headline: Equitable of Iowa Q4 net up after purchase.

text.p: Equitable of Iowa Cos said Wednesday additional revenue from its newly acquired Golden American unit helped earnings climb in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
Equitable reported net income of $29.5 million, or $0.92 a share, compared to $7.6 million, or $0.24 a share, one year ago.

The company said the year-ago results reflected a $23.4-million accrual for guaranty fund assessments after taxes. The company said the assessments cover liability for insurance industry insolvencies unrelated to its operations.
Equitable also said it was comfortable with analysts' estimates of operating earnings for fiscal 1997 landing between $3.90 and $4.10 a share.
Its shares were trading up 3/8 at 47-7/8.
